title: Cambridge Student Housing Report
snippet: Average studio rent near Harvard Square runs $2,200-$2,800/month; several buildings offer student-aligned academic-year leases.
full_text: The City of Cambridge's housing division reports that average studio apartment rent within a half-mile of Harvard Square ranges from $2,200 to $2,800 per month as of late 2025. Several nearby buildings offer 9- or 10-month leases aligned with the academic calendar, aimed at Harvard and Lesley University students.
claim_text: Studio apartments near Harvard Square typically rent for $2,200-$2,800/month, and some buildings offer student-aligned academic-year leases.

title: Harvard Square Rent Trends
snippet: Rents around Harvard Square remain among the highest in the Boston metro area, driven by proximity to Harvard University.
full_text: A 2025 review of Boston-area rental listings found that Harvard Square commands some of the highest per-square-foot rents in the metro region, largely due to walkability to Harvard University and the MBTA Red Line. Shared apartments split among 3-4 roommates were the most common strategy students used to manage costs.
claim_text: Studio apartments near Harvard Square typically rent for $2,200-$2,800/month, and some buildings offer student-aligned academic-year leases.
